metadata.purpose: Single machine-readable source of behavioral truth for the six router-shaped OpenCode command families. Templates, validators, benchmark adapters, and generated routers consume this instead of restating it as prose.
metadata.confirm_auto_relationship: The observed 'confirm == auto + checkpoints' relationship holds only for light single-pass mode-pair families (verified on design; inferred for create and speckit:plan). For autonomy-heavy commands (speckit:complete, all deep:*) the :auto workflow carries orchestration machinery the :confirm variant lacks, so the two are divergent siblings and must be modeled independently rather than derived. Downstream checks must not assume the invariant universally.
metadata.granularity: One entry per family; router_path is a directory glob for families whose per-operation routers share one uniform pattern (create, design, deep) and an explicit list for families whose routers differ (speckit, memory, doctor).
metadata.coverage: Covers the six router-shaped families only. The prompt and rewrite groups and the three root-level utilities (/agent-router, /goal-opencode, /vision) ship no family router and carry no entry here; a consumer that walks this file is walking 31 of the 39 shipped commands, not all of them.
metadata.asset_naming: Owned assets are hyphen-joined: <family>-<command>-<kind> for create, speckit, doctor and deep. A family whose commands already read unambiguously drops the family prefix and names assets <command>-<kind> — the memory family (save.md/search.md, now hosted under the speckit command folder as /speckit:save and /speckit:search; save-presentation.txt) and design (extract-auto.yaml) both do. The kind suffixes are -presentation.txt, -auto.yaml and -confirm.yaml. Underscores are not used; the shipped prompt group is the tree's lone underscore holdout and is out of scope here.
metadata.path_templates: A per-command asset path carries exactly one <placeholder>, which expands to the router's command name. generate-command-routers.cjs special-cases the memory family key (the internal contract identifier for the save/search direct-dispatch commands) when the placeholder opens the basename; a prefix-dropping family it does not special-case must therefore spell its assets literally rather than as a template, which is why design carries concrete filenames.

loader_requirements: Read the presentation asset and _routes.yaml before dispatch

The manifest exposes each route's mutation class (read-only | add-only | mutates) and gate-3 location before acting
/doctor:update carries no required positional: input.required is true for the speckit and mcp routers only
update acquires a flock before database-rebuild probes and may end STATUS=RESTART_REQUIRED

loader_requirements: Read the presentation asset before showing any startup question
